view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of an industrial warehouse interior with concrete flooring and high ceilings. Rows of large white roll-up doors line the right wall, marked with numbers like '43' and '44'. Red forklifts and pallets are visible in the background. Yellow protective bollards stand near doorways. Fluorescent lights illuminate the space from above.

objects.label: warehouse doors
objects.observation: Large white roll-up doors dominate the right side of the frame. They have red horizontal stripes and numbered labels (e.g., '43', '44'). Some have small windows. Doors appear closed and are mounted on concrete pillars.

objects.label: yellow bollards
objects.observation: Several bright yellow cylindrical bollards are positioned at the base of the warehouse doors. They are freestanding and appear to be made of plastic or metal, providing protection against impacts.

objects.label: red forklifts
objects.observation: Multiple red forklifts are parked along the left and center areas. One is closer to the foreground on the left, while others are further back near stacks of red crates. They are stationary and appear to be electric models.

objects.label: pallets
objects.observation: Wooden pallets are stacked in the far-left background, near the forklifts. They are arranged in orderly rows and appear to be empty or partially loaded with goods.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Long fluorescent light fixtures hang from the ceiling, evenly spaced across the width of the warehouse. They provide bright illumination and are suspended by metal brackets.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: The entire ground surface is smooth, gray concrete. A small yellow object lies near the bottom-left corner. The floor shows minor scuff marks and is uncluttered except for the aforementioned items.

State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}

Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.
